decision.explanation: The question asks for the medium of 'The English Patient.' Multiple documents provide distinct claims about this title. Document D1S1 explicitly states it is a 1992 novel by Michael Ondaatje. Document D3S1 similarly describes it as a 1992 video game by the same author. Document D6S1 refers to an audio edition narrated by Michael York, and D6S2 mentions a 1996 film version directed by Anthony Minghella. These are separate works sharing the same title, each described in their own context. Therefore, all four forms—novel, film, audio edition, and video game—are valid answers.
